title: Non-calculate fields with a calculation expression must have readonly=yes
description: Every survey row that has a non-empty calculation expression must carry readonly=yes — EXCEPT rows where type=calculate. OC type=calculate is a hidden background field; adding readonly to it is invalid and causes "Element cannot be defined as type=calculate and readonly". For visible calculated values use type=text + readonly=yes + calculation. This convention enforces readonly=yes on type=text/integer/decimal/date/etc. with calculations but explicitly excludes type=calculate rows.
rationale: OC has two different rules: (1) non-calculate types with a calculation MUST have readonly=yes or OC rejects with "cannot have calculation unless read-only"; (2) type=calculate rows MUST NOT have readonly=yes or OC rejects with "cannot be defined as type=calculate and readonly". The most common violation is AGE (type=integer + calculation + no readonly). type=calculate background fields never need readonly.

flag.message: Field ${field.name} on ${form.form_id} has a calculation expression but was missing readonly=yes. Auto-enforced per §29 (OC platform requirement). If this field also needs a trigger, add it to the trigger column and this convention will no longer apply.

history.note: Implements §29 of conventions.md as a structured conventions engine rule so it is enforced deterministically on every spec regardless of LLM first-pass consistency. The applies_when checks calculation non-empty AND trigger empty AND readonly != yes — the ensure directive sets readonly=yes only when all three hold. Paired with the existing field_types.visible_calculated_uses_text_type convention which handles the type=calculate visibility concern.

Added field.type != calculate exclusion to applies_when. Previously the convention applied to ALL types including type=calculate, incorrectly adding readonly=yes to background calculate fields, causing OC rejection: "cannot be defined as type=calculate and readonly". Confirmed affected forms: ECONSENT (ACKNOWLEDGE_CALC) and BIOIVTONC (ORG_SITE_CALC) on Detroit DS New study.
